title: Lekalo change policy
description: Closed contract of one change acceptance policy (issue #73). A policy may authorize otherwise-denied breaking compatibility classes for reviewed batches; it can never disable structural validity, semantic validation, path safety, ownership proofs, or required evidence. Absent members are the restrictive defaults: no breaking class is allowed, so every valid breaking candidate stays denied.

evidence.description: Reviewed evidence pins. Data-loss and storage-migration classes can only be authorized by a policy that carries the reviewed migration-plan digest; the boolean acknowledgement flag alone is never sufficient.
